basis: Neurodevelopmental disability defines the syndrome; structural heart abnormalities occur in 30-79%. Renal and hearing abnormalities are under 30%.
Inherited skeletal disorder defined by multiple focal areas of increased bone density.
Congenital temporal dermal defects define it; trichiasis/distichiasis occur in 80-99% and eyelid ectropion in 30-79%.
Organized thrombi obstruct pulmonary arteries and cause pulmonary hypertension/right heart dysfunction; respiratory measurements do not establish direct airway or parenchymal damage.
Inherited chronic neutrophil deficiency; periodontal damage lacks evidence of frequency >=30%. Benign familial neutropenia does not itself establish immunodeficiency.
Ependymal neoplasm originating in the supratentorial brain.
Proteasome autoinflammation with chronic panniculitis/lipodystrophy; inflammatory muscle/joint disease with contractures is characteristic and common (>=30%); hepatic frequency uncertain.
Glioneuronal neoplasm originating in the central nervous system and involving leptomeninges.
Retinal dysfunction and skeletal abnormalities define it; cognitive impairment occurs in 30-79%. Caries is separately diagnosed; palate shape alone does not establish damage.
Manganese transport disorder with dystonia (14/15) and cirrhosis (5/6); polycythemia is a defining feature occurring in 30-79%.
Inherited retinal cone/cone-rod degeneration.
Developmental delay and intellectual disability occur in all reported patients. Hypotonia is neurologic; long fingers and high palate alone do not establish organ damage.
Carcinoma originating in the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes; keratinization does not indicate skin origin.
Cancer originating in the fallopian tube, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Severe craniofacial/limb defects with cleft palate; CNS and cardiac malformations occur in 30-79%. Microtia (80-99%) omitted at cap; lung abnormalities lack frequency data.
Autoinflammatory syndrome; supplied HPO reports pericarditis 80-99%, pleuritis and arthritis 30-79%. Rash/conjunctival injection are transient; amyloidosis is a minority complication.
Cerebrovascular disease produces repeated cerebral infarctions and permanent cognitive impairment.
Inflammation directly affects the brain and spinal cord; infectious and immune-mediated causes account for the usual disease spectrum.
ANCA-associated immune-mediated glomerular injury defines the disease; extrarenal manifestations occur in systemic forms but are not established in >=30% across this concept.
Mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation disorder; hypertrophic cardiomyopathy in 5/5 and developmental delay in 3/5. Hearing impairment in 1/5 is below threshold.
Congenital complete atrioventricular canal defect with left heart obstruction.
Defining dermal lymphatic tumor infiltration causes persistent skin dysfunction. Breast origin has no axis; the inflammatory name does not indicate immune-mediated disease.
Francisella tularensis infection directly involves the lungs.
Localized macular capillary abnormalities and retinal neurodegeneration cause progressive central visual loss.
Benign smooth muscle tumor originating in the small intestine; visceral smooth muscle is not skeletal muscle.
